newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Shougang steel output 5.2 mln T Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: China's Shougang steel output 5.2 mln T Jan-Aug.

text.p: China's Capital Iron and Steel Co (Shougang) produced 5.2 million tonnes of steel in the first eight months of the year and achieved after-tax profits of 150 million yuan ($18 million), the China Daily said on Thursday.
Output of rolled steel was 4.57 million tonnes, the newspaper said but gave no comparative figures.
Despite improvements to efficency and growing output, the group was still suffering from a lack of funds, the newspaper said.
A large number of short-term loans taken out to help launch group projects had fallen due, and Shougang was also burdened by unprofitable construction firms, it said but gave no details.
Shougang, one of China's largest steelmakers, has forecast 1996 profits at 300 million yuan.
